newsitem.title: POLAND: FLEMINGS GIVES IRENA "BUY FOR SHORT TERM" RATING.
newsitem.headline: FLEMINGS GIVES IRENA "BUY FOR SHORT TERM" RATING.

text.p: Investors should buy the shares of glass crystal maker Irena SA for short-term price gains, as the exporter will benefit from the relative strength of dollar and the pound, Flemings' Research said.
"The outlook for short term profit growth in Irena seems good," the report dated July 8 said. "Year-on-year profit comparison will benefit from the reltively poor 1996", the report added.
Irena's sales went up by 22 percent in the first five months of 1997 and operating profits increased from 1.1 to 3.7 million zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
